name: Fix Azure DevOps
description: Adds missing features to Azure DevOps.
features: Pipeline status on pull requests
How long ago each active pull request in a list was published, in red after two weekdays
A Pipeline tab on each pull request with its runs, stages, steps, warnings, errors and logs
Buttons to start, cancel or open a run
A run page's tabs, such as Extensions, as tabs of the pull request
Each check's warnings and errors above the description, in a box that collapses
An Overview from old to new, with buttons to flip it and to go to its bottom
Pushes folded to one line, with a button that shows their commits
Lines that add reviewers joined to one
Threads that collapse, with Resolved and Unresolved chips and a button that expands them all
Unread comments that glow, with buttons to the first and next unread
A New chip on pushes and other changes you have not seen
Required reviewers first
Starred reviewers to add in one click, also on a new pull request
Reviews that post your pending comments in one go with your vote
A Viewed checkbox on each file in the Files tab, as on GitHub
Avatar initials
Light or Dark to match the system
Days in column dots on board cards, with a toggle per column
Pull request lists and boards that reload on changes
A Windows 98 mode, a work in progress and off by default
A settings panel in the top bar that turns each feature on or off and marks new ones
